frame.world: every room outline and every object x,y is in WORLD metres (the map.json frame: origin the ferry landing, x east, y north), inside the plot outline; outline is the room rectangle as four world corners (in order: left end of the entry wall, right end, right end inward, left end inward)
frame.local: outline_local = [x0,y0,x1,y1] and object.local = [x,y] are in the plot's own frame: x runs along the entry wall from its left end (seen from inside, facing in) and y runs inward from the entry wall; the frame is that of the plot's frame_door; rooms in one plot share it
frame.z: height_m is the ceiling height; yards and outdoor rooms carry height 0 and outdoor true

search_s.safe: 6 once opened; needs its key or the combination from a person

rules.search_s_src: 1.6.2 gives drawer 2, desk 4, wardrobe 5; cupboard 4, chest 5, safe 6 chosen
rules.dark_without_torch: search time doubles (search_s_dark_no_torch on every container)

noise_m.src: 1.6.2: drawer about 2 m, a forced cupboard about 10 m at night; desk 3, wardrobe 4, safe 2 chosen

force_door.src: 1.6.1: force is loud, shows for a day and is a crime; the 15 m is chosen (a drawer 2 m, a cupboard 10 m)

rules.three_ways_in: every locked break-in room has key_lent_or_copied (Ian Megginson, who knows every lock; a copy cut at the ironmonger for 1.50), key_lifted (a held pocket lift of about 2 s) and force; where a routine leaves a way open there is also back_way

owner_warn.private: first warning at 5 s after the sighting, second at 15 s, then the owner or a neighbour calls someone or acts by 30 s at worst; warnings reset when Tom is out of sight; the sighting is kept for good
owner_warn.forbidden: no first warning; second warning at 5 s, then acts by 30 s
owner_warn.src: 1.6.1: warns, warns again, then calls or acts, within half a minute at worst

rules.taking: one press takes what is found; what is taken can be found on him; the Ledger says what was taken (1.6.2 checklist)
rules.hot_goods: goods with hot true carry a hot mark that fades with value and distance; the owner recognises them (1.6.3)

ordinary_drawer.same_act: same search time, noise and memory as in a job
ordinary_drawer.how_used: containers with ordinary true hold one or two of the set (fixed per container); spare_key_to_this_room is a room's spare key and works as the key_lifted way

boot.slot_note: the boot uses the same seven-slot unit as Tom's hands (chosen); a body fills every slot
boot.search_rule: opening the boot is an act seen like any act (witness memory written); a constable who stops the car with cause may look in it and finds everything in it

open_points: Dispute: the prototype ROOMS put Mickey's at 13.6 x 8 m and the blockout 6 x 8; the map plot is 8 x 6 m. Rooms follow the map plot (newer, frozen), with a front office, back room, stair hall and inner office inside it.
Dispute: the old boxing hours (17:00-22:00 in way.js) differ from 7.16 (18:00-21:30 Mon, Wed, Fri; 10:00-13:00 Sat). 7.16 is used.
Dispute: the prototype has the Golden River takeaway; it is ruled out (bay 3 empty to let). No room built.

The map has no door for: a caff or shop yard/back door (caff, Metcalfe's, the second-hand shop, the snooker hall, the boxing hall, chandlery, tea room), the caff's delivery door, the net loft's own back, a second escape door from Mickey's yard (only the quay gate and the back-fence vault), and the flat's own door (the stair is internal). Those rooms have lent/lifted/force ways but no back_way; the caff_back delivery door is drawn as an object with no door id.
The map flags some doors unlocked that no room uses (d_nr_36 corner shop, d_lot_hut, d_cold_yard, the quay and gate doors); they are in locked_doors with a note. Decide whether they need rooms.

The retired doctor, the barber, the pigeon loft's keeper and the boxing trainers (three chosen) have no cast entry yet.
Darren Milner lives at his mother's: no plot is named for it; home_nr_12, home_cl_9 and home_cs_house_3 are generic.
Two pawns (Rita's on Quay Street, Wayne Harrison's on North Road) are both built, as the map's open point says.

The old spec had Sheila at a desk in the back room; she now keeps the counter and the back room is the kettle room and the tin (mickeys-office.json mark note, 29 Oct); the inner office is Mickey's own (27 Oct).
Yards (Mickey's, Iveson's) have room_kind null and reverb_id null: open air uses the street bed; sounds.json has no yard kind (ask whether back_room should serve).

Tin: RULINGS 4.3.2 says a tin under the floorboards in the flat; 2.7.2 says the night-money tin is at the office. Both are built (office tin = night money; flat tin = Tom's own stash) and prompt.tin serves both.
